The LV of the Seeker Flame is equal to the user's level, and only one can be active at a time.

skills.name: Stalwart Guardian
skills.description: Reduces redirected and reflected damage by 15%. If the owner of this skill is Kerberos, the reduction is increased to 40%.

skills.name: Fire Jet
skills.description: Releases a super fast jet of fire in a line, dealing Fire magic damage to all enemies within that line. All tiles in the line are also covered in Cinders for 2 rounds that deal damage equal to 50% of the user's Fire ATK.

This also applies to the Summoner if the Summoner installs a Dragon-race Youkai. (Multiple instances of this skill do not stack.)

skills.description: Creates a lance made of focus at your current location and fires it in a line in the direction you are facing, which deals Light magic damage to the first enemy hit. The maximum range of this skill increases by 1 per 10 Izabe levels.

skills.name: Umbrella Flap
skills.description: A sudden opening of an umbrella, which deals Wind magic damage to all enemies in a 1 Size Circle around the user, and applies Aero Shift (2) to field tiles. skills.name: Ruby Beam

skills.name: Positive Thinker

skills.name: Burst of Fire
skills.description: Targets 1 enemy within 5 Range, then wrap yourself with the power of the fire elemental Nerhaven (if no elemental is active) until your next turn, and then deal Fire magic damage to the target. If the user of the skill is Fire Elemental, the elemental effect is permanent, and the Range is increased by 2. (LV = Fire Elemental's LV/10, min. 2 max. 5)

skills.name: Barrier of Fire
skills.description: +3 Armor versus weapons made of Wood. If the owner of this skill is Fire Elemental, they gain +15 Armor instead.

skills.name: Elemental of Fire
skills.description: +15% Fire Resistance, Nerhaven provides +10 Scaled Weapon Attack. If the owner of this skill is Fire Elemental, they reflect Fire damage, and gain immunity to Burn, Poison, and Immobilize.

skills.name: Phase Fang
skills.description: Performs a basic attack on an enemy within 1 Range that deals bonus damage equal to Phase Python's level/3. If it hits, it may inflict Poison LV X (X = Level/2, min. 3), and if you're in the tile the enemy is facing, you teleport back to the tile you began the round on. If you are on any other tile, if any other enemies are in the battle, you are teleported behind a random one.

skills.name: Vile Mastery
skills.description: Grants Poison Resistance equal to Level/2%. Phase Python itself receives 40+Level% instead.

skills.name: Slither Mastery
skills.description: Has both passive and active components. Passively, Movement becomes teleport, and total movement speed penalties are reduced by 15+Level% (Phase Python receives 100% immunity). When activated, any Immobilize effect on the user is instantly ended.

skills.name: Whirlpool
skills.description: Creates a whirlpool around the user, dealing Water magic damage with Great Accuracy to all within 3 Range. Damaged enemies are also pulled toward the user by 1 square.

skills.name: Painful Accuracy
skills.description: The owner of this skill possess attacks that hit in... tender places. Grants the owner of the skill +2 SKI, and causes their Kicks to deal +6 damage.

skills.name: Seafarer
skills.description: A being that lives and travels in the sea. Grants immunity to Water damage.

skills.name: Shatter Beam
skills.description: Fires a beam from the Terrasque's chest, dealing Earth physical damage. In addition, it reduces the target's DEF and RES by 1+(Terrasque Level/12) for 3 rounds.

skills.name: Skitterscale
skills.description: Possesses a body that is both protective and flexible. Increases Evade by 5 and Defense by 2. Terrasque gets +10 Evade instead.

skills.name: Regrowth
skills.description: A rapid regeneration of the body, which restores 2 HP every round.

skills.name: Burst of Wind
skills.description: Targets 1 enemy within 5 Range, then wrap yourself with the power of the wind elemental Talvyd (if no elemental is active) until your next turn, and then deal Wind magic damage to the target. If the user of the skill is Wind Elemental, the elemental effect is permanent, and the Range is increased by 2. (LV = Wind Elemental's LV/10, min. 2 max. 5)

skills.name: Barrier of Wind
skills.description: +5 Evade versus ranged weapons. If the owner of this skill is Wind Elemental, they gain +20 Evade instead.

skills.name: Elemental of Wind
skills.description: +15% Wind Resistance, Talvyd provides +10 Evade. If the owner of this skill is Wind Elemental, they reflect Wind damage, and gain immunity to Burn, Poison, and Immobilize.

skills.name: Drown
skills.description: Create a ball of water around the target's head (or whatever counts as it), dealing Water magic damage. If the user is Drowned Woman, there is also a chance that it will Silence the target for 3 rounds.

skills.name: Ghost Sea
skills.description: Property belonging to those who have died at sea. Grants immunity to Burn status. User is treated as Ghost-race in addition to all other racial types.

skills.name: Ammendum, Sin, and Purpose
skills.description: An irregularity that results in an incorporeal body. Grants 50% Slash, Blunt, and Pierce resistance, but also grants a 25% weakness to Dark damage. (Only 25% for non-Drowned Woman units).

skills.name: Wink
skills.description: A low-grade enchantment that is triggered by a wink. May inflict Charm LV X (X = half of Lilu's level) on the target for 3 turns.

skills.name: Nightshade
skills.description: A protective charm that is powered by the night. They gain +2 DEF and +2 RES.

skills.name: Embrace
skills.description: Attempts to pull the target close, applying the Grapple skill to them. If the target is Charmed by the user, the Grapple is always successful. If used by Lilu, the Range increases to 8, and they will teleport to an empty tile next to the target.

skills.name: Ichor Veil
skills.description: Costs 10% of max HP. Targets 1 other allied unit within 5 Range, granting them Ichor Veil LV X (X = 10% of max HP, 3 rounds). If the user of this skill is Nacht, they can target themself to create a burst of blood, dealing Water + Dark magic damage to all enemies within a 3 Size Circle (damage increased by HP consumed). If the summoner has the Claret Call skill active, damaged enemies have it applied to them. Additionally, when used by Nacht, this skill's CD is reduced by 1 round.

skills.name: Bloodstained Night
skills.description: When this unit is defeated, the battlefield is covered in a Bloodstained Night effect (LV = Nacht's level, 5 rounds). If the owner of this skill is Nacht, after 3 rounds (or when the battle ends), they recover to full HP (in an unsummoned state).

skills.name: Midnight Ruler
skills.description: On New Round: If it is night, or the owner of this skill is standing in a Darkness tile, they gain Midnight Ruler LV X (X = higher of 25% of Nacht's level or 5, 3 rounds) if they do not already have it. If the owner of this skill is Nacht, this effect also applies when summoned and is permanent when it does.

skills.name: Frostbite
skills.description: Fangs of ice appear around the target and bite down, dealing Ice physical damage. It also inflicts Frostbite LVX (Yuki-onna's LV/2, min. 2) for 2 rounds. (Frostbite causes unresistible LV Ice damage every time the afflicted unit walks on an Ice Sheet.)

skills.name: Snowshoes
skills.description: Being prepared to walk on unstable footing, the owner of this skill does not suffer reduced movement nor break Ice Sheets during Move.

skills.name: Snow Crest
skills.description: Possessed by beings born of the snow. Reflects Ice damage, but suffers a 50% Vulnerability to Fire damage.

skills.name: Fire Wall
skills.description: A shriek that sends flames shooting at the target. Deals Fire magic damage to a target enemy within 4 Range and has a chance to inflict Fear for 2 rounds. If unit is Stoked, Range increases by 3, targets a 3 Size Circle, damage by 25%, gains Great Accuracy, and has a chance to inflict Burn LV 15 for 2 rounds, but it consumes the Stoked effect.

skills.name: Sinister Regrowth
skills.description: +5 HP Regeneration. If the owner of this skill is Jack o' Lantern, then at the start of a new round: If within 1 Range of a Hardiness 1 plant field tile, consumes and destroys 1 of those tiles to restore HP equal to level x 2, and this unit becomes Stoked and cures any Burn they possess. (Stoked causes basic attacks to deal Fire magic bonus damage equal to 30% of Fire ATK on hit, grants immunity to Burn, and grants +25 Evade.) This effect has a 3 round cooldown.

skills.name: Autumn Animation
skills.description: A plant said to come alive when covered in dead leaves. Grants +15% Earth Resistance and +15% Water Resistance, but also gives a 15% Fire Weakness. If the owner of this skill is Jack o' Lantern, instead grants +50% Earth Resistance, absorbs Water damage, and has a 25% Fire Weakness.

skills.name: Deathtouch
skills.description: Touches a target within 2 Range with a cold, arcane hand, dealing magic damage split between Ice and Darkness damage.

skills.name: Nightshade
skills.description: A protective charm that is powered by the night. They gain +2 DEF and +2 RES.

skills.name: Chain Cast
skills.description: After casting a spell while Orbello is Installed, you gain a status that increases your Spell Power by 1 and reduces Spell Costs by 10% for 2 rounds. Additional spell casts increase the effect and duration by 1 (as well as the cost reduction by 10%), to a maximum of 3+(Orbello's Level/10), and a maximum duration of 2 rounds.

skills.name: Ingrain
skills.description: Dig your roots into the ground, gaining Immobilize for 3 rounds. If you use this skill while already Immobilized, if it was caused by yourself, the status is removed.

skills.name: Synthesis
skills.description: At the start of a new round, if the owner of this skill is Immobilized, all enemies within 3 Range are drained for half of the owner's LV in HP. The owner of this skill is then healed for that total amount in HP.

skills.name: Demon Plant
skills.description: A plant capable of growing in the soil of Hell itself. Grants 25% Dark Resistance, but also gives a 25% Light Weakness. In addition, 10% of the damage dealt by the owner of this skill is returned to them as HP.
